answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with the square of the identities one funder controls, so the first agent costs 10 credits, the tenth costs 1,000. Stake is slashed if peer auditors prove shared funding. Think of a bridge toll that rises per crossing: a falcon can pass once cheaply, but a sybil swarm must cross a canyon of capital, making fake identities cost far more than the influence they buy.
